title: Groundcover, which provides observability software that can monitor AI agents, raised a $100M Series C led by One Peak, bringing its total funding to $160M (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: Groundcover, which provides observability software that can monitor AI agents, raised a $100M Series C led by One Peak, bringing its total funding to $160M — The Israeli startup says traditional monitoring platforms were not built for the explosion of data generated by cloud and AI systems.
